scope: Compare public peer evidence for canonical MLEADER DXF spelling, DWG custom-class route, and per-version writer declarations; refine route-specific evidence gates without treating declarations as semantic proof.

sources.name: LibreCAD bundled-fork coverage inventory
observations: Inventory lists DXF MULTILEADER as typed read/write, MLEADER as not typed, and DWG ACDBMULTILEADER plus MLEADERSTYLE custom-object routes as not typed.
Inventory marks these routes fixture-needed; rows are coverage claims, not independent semantic or native-application results.

sources.name: LibreCAD bundled-fork libdxfrw API
observations: The header declares writeMultiLeader and processMultiLeader; declarations alone do not prove implementation completeness or interoperability.

sources.name: LibreDWG project documentation
observations: Project documentation says its DWG writer cannot create R2007 DWG and describes DXF/DXFB/JSON conversion routes, illustrating why writer support must be version- and operation-scoped.

sources.name: ACadSharp published compatibility matrix
observations: Published matrix marks AC1021 DWG writing unsupported while several later AC versions are listed supported; this is a project capability declaration, not MLEADER-specific test evidence.

sources.name: Local libdxfrw source
observations: This checkout dispatches and low-level writes canonical MULTILEADER; adapter export still refuses because no qualified dx_iface entity serializer exists.

method: Inspected public source/documentation and local dispatch/output code. No peer binary, CAD application, downloadable drawing, or external test corpus was run or added.
sourceRevisionStatus: GitHub branch-head links were inspected as live source pages; exact commit SHAs were not pinned in this research pass. Pin immutable revisions before executing differential tests or treating these declarations as release-qualified evidence.
planChanges: Separate DXF entity spelling/parse/write from DWG custom-class read and MLEADERSTYLE object closure.
Keep canonical MULTILEADER as the only supported token pending explicit alias controls.
Require peer ledger rows to pin exact revision, format, direction, token/class, target AC version, control provenance, semantic fields, and result.
Do not infer native or semantic support from inventory labels, API declarations, or library-wide writer matrices.
